name: KELLY
tagline: Track sprinter known across Bermuda for blinding flanks and first-shot crits.
biography: A high-school track prodigy whose real name is Shimada Kiriko, Kelly is relentless, cheerful, and fiercely competitive on the field. Sporting her signature yellow tracksuit and black hair with crimson-tipped ends, she outpaces danger and rallies her squad to never stop moving forward.
